image_description: A view from inside a dark, stone-walled room looking out through a large arched window fitted with heavy iron bars. The window is open to the right, revealing a bright exterior scene with a body of water (sea or bay) and distant buildings on a hillside. Strong sunlight casts grid-like shadows from the bars onto the interior wall and floor.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is classified as a prison/correctional facility rather than a generic historical building or castle.
To verify the physical separation between the interior bars and the exterior landscape, ensuring no 'melting' or depth collapse where the bars meet the background.
To ensure the grid of bars is topologically consistent (no broken or floating segments) and sharply defined against the bright background.

focus_areas: Integrity of the iron bar grid (continuity and straightness)
Lighting consistency (shadows cast by bars matching the light source)
Boundary sharpness between bars and the bright exterior
Texture realism of the stone/masonry walls
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the iron bars and the window frame. AI often struggles with the occlusion logic here, causing bars to merge into the frame or background. Verify that the shadows cast on the interior wall align geometrically with the angle of the bars and the apparent position of the sun.
